description: Defines an abstract class LocalPlayer for media playback, including nested classes for SurfaceView and Overlay playback, handling media control, presentation, and surface management.

classes.name: LocalPlayer
classes.description: Abstract class managing media playback with nested classes for SurfaceView and Overlay playback, handling media control, surface updates, and presentation.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.SurfaceViewPlayer
classes.description: Handles media playback using MediaPlayer with SurfaceView, managing surface lifecycle and presentation display.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.OverlayPlayer
classes.description: Handles media playback using MediaPlayer with overlay window, managing overlay lifecycle and aspect ratio.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.SurfaceViewPlayer.DemoPresentation
classes.description: Presentation class for displaying media on a secondary display with adjustable size.

methods.name: LocalPlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and resetting media player.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a media route, logs connection if debugging.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases media player resources and dismisses presentation if any.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of a media item, setting data source and preparing asynchronously.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of the media item.

methods.name: onPrepared
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when media is prepared; updates state and starts playback if pending.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when media playback completes.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback on error; notifies callback.

methods.name: onSeekComplete
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when seek completes; updates position.

methods.name: updateSurface
methods.description: Updates MediaPlayer surface based on current surface or holder.

methods.name: updateVideoRect
methods.description: Updates video rectangle dimensions based on media size.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Abstract method to update video size; implemented in subclasses.
